thread:
violet: Quick note — customers hitting poor p95 for short chat calls after updating to rw-python-sdk v1.6.2. Symptoms look like connection churn + small semaphore defaults.
sam: Can you paste a log? suspect pool waiting.
violet: snippet:
```
2026-03-30T16:42:10Z WARN pool: acquire_wait=254ms inflight=92 pool_semaphore=16 queue_len=120
2026-03-30T16:42:10Z ERROR req=9a2 timeout after 5s
```
jun: Looks like defaults are too conservative for chat workloads. Also saw customers set SESSION_LIFETIME quoted in helm which coerced to string and got parsed to default 60s.
violet: repro small bench: 300 concurrent workers sending 1-2 token prompts repeatedly -> errors on v1.6.2 but not on 1.5.x.
sam: Mitigation: bump RW_POOL_SEMAPHORE to 256 in infra and ensure SESSION_LIFETIME unquoted. We should ship a patch to warn on quoted numerics.
jun: Agreed. Follow-ups: add onboarding doc note in devex quickstart, add unit test for env parsing, and add telemetry metric pool.acquire_wait_ms with p95 alert.
ops-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-python-sdk/issues/561 and started canary config roll at 16:58 UTC
violet: Thanks team — I'll update the quickstart and examples in docs and add a sample helm values file showing numeric envs.
